name: D_gen2_bench
description: A benchmark intended to evaluate generative-model outputs across prompts, focusing on output quality, fidelity, and alignment with requested content. It provides prompts and corresponding target/reference outputs (or evaluation protocol) and is designed to support both automated and human assessments of generation quality. The benchmark targets model comparison for generation tasks rather than a single narrow subtask.
reputation: A small Hugging Face-hosted benchmark for generative-model evaluation with limited community visibility outside its contributors.
